title: Individual Determinants of Antidepressant Response- a longitudinal study
summary: Ziel der IDeA-L Studie ist es, Ansprechwahrscheinlichkeiten auf eine antidepressive Pharmakotherapie besser vorhersagen zu können. Dabei sollen schwer depressiv Erkrankte über einen Zeitraum von zwei Jahren in acht Untersuchungszeitpunkten über verschiedene Untersuchungsmodalitäten hinweg phänotypisiert werden.
conditions: Severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms

interventions.name: Patients with severe depression and indication of treatment with antidepressants will be observed (clinical data, biomaterial, neuroimaging, electrophysiology) in a longitudinal course without intervention.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Moderate to severe unipolar depression
< 60 years at first episode
stationary or ambulatory treatment in the clinic
indication for an antidepressive medication
fluent german
MRI-suitable
Exclusion criteria:
Indication for an ECT, Ketamin or sleep-deprivation therapy
DSM-5 diagnose of dementia, schizophrenia, schizo- or bipolare depressive disorder
current pregnancy
traumatic brain injury in medical history
severe internistic or neurological underlying disease
